items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Could have been. I think I remember the name.

ctx.x: Not particularly. They didn't use this too much. In fact, Dewey Jackson played much too loud. He was a loud type and featured himself a great deal. And that was one of the drawbacks. He did play pretty loud, Dewey Jackson did.
I think of that drum. Floyd Campbell, I guess his name was. He sang and played drums, I think with Dewey. Maybe he played with the Press, too.
Could have been. I think I remember the name.
